turns.note: The code is typed in lower case with spaces: the lookup must normalise it to find the case.

turns.mechanic: Measured all four reference points on level ground and ran PROC_TAS_X_CALIBRATE-RIDE-HEIGHT in Toolbox. Values accepted, alert cleared after a short drive.

Give the reference points as in the case: front, ground to the rearmost mounting bolt of the front subframe; rear, ground to the front mounting bolt of the rear subframe
Say the measurement is not taken from the wheel centre or the fender lip
Say this alert alone does not establish a failed ride-height sensor

Present the case as a manufacturer procedure
State a pin, value or specification that is not in the case
case_in_kb.final_cause: No valid ride-height calibration values stored in the TAS ECU; calibrated with Tesla Toolbox
